scope: Explanation of already recorded counters from previously inspected frozen definitions; no new execution, input reading, measurement, tokenization or trajectory scan

definitions.actual_page_read_requests: Number of actual model decisions whose action is read_test_result and whose model_call_id belongs to the recorded actual-input call set.
definitions.verified_page_feedback_returns: Sum across immutable report histories of verified page-bearing feedback entries. Both run_tests and read_test_result can produce a page-bearing feedback entry. Each verified feedback entry contributes one fragment, regardless of how many later inputs contain that feedback.
definitions.run_tests_initial_page: A successful verified run_tests page return is required to be page index 0, so the initial test response contributes its first page without an explicit read_test_result action.

decomposition.basis: Existing aggregate contains47 run_tests feedback entries,32 verified explicit read outcomes and79 verified page-feedback entries; frozen helper only admits these two tool origins. No new per-feedback traversal was performed for this explanation.

not_equivalent_to: 32 explicit read calls producing79 independent response envelopes
79 unique page positions or unique page contents
79 repeated presentation occurrences across later model inputs
recommended_wording: 32 explicit page-read actions;79 verified page-bearing feedback entries, comprising47 initial pages returned by run_tests and32 explicit page-read returns. Unique page count and semantic use are not inferred.

frozen_definition_sources.definition: verified_page_feedback_returns sums each report history's verified_page_feedback_count; the adjacent actual_page_read_requests expression counts read_test_result actual model decisions.
Only run_tests/read_test_result feedback is eligible; run_tests is checked to return index0.
verified_page_feedback_count is len(fragments), with one fragment per associated verified feedback entry; actual_inputs are stored within the fragment and are not multiplied into this count.
